open_blocking.title: The PR body falsely says #577's batch test covers same-bytes dedupe, and same-bytes dedupe within one batch has no working test
open_blocking.evidence: In the PR body, criterion 2 is ticked as covered 'by #577's unchanged "stages one chip when one batch repeats the same file" test, which includes a distinct File object with the same bytes'. That test (src/components/chat/PromptComposer.test.tsx:335-345) stages [file, file, sameNameSizeAndDate]. It then calls settle() once (setTimeout 0) and asserts 1 chip. At head, sameNameSizeAndDate is held back for a digest (PromptComposer.tsx:217-238), so the assertion runs before the digest resolves and gets 1 chip whatever the dedupe result. Mutation 3 changes PromptComposer.tsx:131-133 so that a digest match returns distinct, which removes content dedupe entirely. Under it, `npx vitest run src/components/chat/PromptComposer.test.tsx` gives 'Tests  1 failed | 22 passed (23)'. Only the new separate-selection test fails; the #577 batch test still passes. I made an untracked scratch copy of the test (since deleted) that adds a 300 ms act-wait after settle(). Under mutation 3 it fails with 'expected ... to have a length of 1 but got 2', and at head it passes. So the #577 test's check that a same-metadata, same-bytes file is deduped has become timing-dependent and vacuous, and nothing tests same-bytes dedupe within one batch. The implementer's mutation set (metadata-only duplicate; null digest comparable) never tried the 'digest match is not a duplicate' direction.
open_blocking.suggested_fix: Add a test that stages one batch with two same-metadata, same-bytes File objects and waits with settleDigests(digest, 2) before asserting 1 chip, or add the digest wait to the #577 batch test, which keeps its intent. Correct the criterion-2 claim in the PR body, and add a 'digest match => distinct' mutation run to the evidence.

nonblocking.title: A file waiting for its digest is invisible, is left out of a submit, and then reappears in the cleared composer
nonblocking.evidence: PromptComposer.tsx:217-238: a metadata-colliding file is only committed after `await Promise.all(...digestStagedFile)`. If handleSubmit (:258-297) runs in that window, it submits `files` without the file. clear() empties stagedFilesRef, and the resumed loop then finds no metadata match and stages the file into the fresh composer. There is no pending indicator. The PR body discloses this as a risk. The window is short for small files and can be longer for large CAD files, because arrayBuffer reads the whole file.
nonblocking.suggested_fix: Optional follow-up: track in-flight staging and have submit await it, or show a pending chip. Out of OVD-634's bounded scope.
